description:
List 1stDibs items in a category, optionally narrowed by filters. Use it when
        the user wants items of a kind rather than a keyword match. Returns 20
        items per page with price, availability, photos, and product page links; descriptions
        are shortened. Pass nextPage as page for more. Filters are a query string like
        category=furniture&location=usa-north-america; get them from read_taxonomy.

filters.description: Filters from read_taxonomy as a query string, such as "category=furniture&location=usa-north-america"

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Use nextPage from the previous result.

name: browse_items
title: Browse 1stDibs Items
